title: Inner Speech
description: An open-access EEG dataset for inner speech recognition recorded from ten participants with a 136-channel acquisition system. It covers three paradigms (inner speech, pronounced speech, and visualized condition) with four command classes (Up, Down, Right, Left) across 5640 trials. It is intended to support brain-computer interface development and the study of the neural mechanisms of the inner voice.
methods_description: Surface electroencephalography was recorded from ten subjects using a 136-channel acquisition system. Three experimental paradigms were employed: inner speech, pronounced speech, and visualized conditions. Subjects performed four directional commands (up, down, right, left) across multiple trials.
